Calculate the target cumulative density value $y$ from the uniform sample $u$ and the total ray optical depth $\tau = \int_{t_n}^{t_f} \sigma_r(s) ds$ using the numerically stable logsumexp operator [S1, unofficial].

The claim states that the target cumulative density value $y$ is calculated from the uniform sample $u$ and the total ray optical depth $	au =  arint_{t_n}^{t_f} 	sigma_r(s) ds$ using the numerically stable logsumexp operator. Source [S1], specifically in Appendix A.2 (Equation 25), explicitly provides the formula: $y = - arlog  arleft(  arexp( arlog(1-u)) +  arexp( arlog u -  arint_{t_n}^{t_f} 	sigma_r(s) ds)  aright)$. The source text confirms this is a rewrite to use the 'more reliable logsumexp operator' for numerical stability. Thus, every fact in the claim is present in the evidence.
